title: Google Trends Scraper
description: Get Google Trends data for keywords: interest over time, interest by region, related queries and topics. Compare up to 5 keywords on one scale and run many countries at once. Optionally get Trending Now searches per country.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to analyse one by one, e.g. 'air fryer'. Each term x each geo = one keyword report.

comparisonGroups.title: Comparison groups (up to 5 terms each)
comparisonGroups.description: Comma-separated terms compared on the same 0-100 scale, like the Compare box on trends.google.com, e.g. 'chatgpt, gemini, claude'. Each group x each geo = one keyword report.

geos.title: Countries / regions
geos.description: Google Trends geo codes. Leave empty or use '' for Worldwide. Examples: 'US', 'GB', 'DE', 'US-CA' (state), 'US-NY-501' (metro). Every term/group runs for every geo.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Preset or custom range. Presets: past-hour, past-4-hours, past-day, past-7-days, past-30-days, past-90-days, past-12-months, past-5-years, since-2004 (also raw values like 'today 12-m'). Custom: '2024-01-01 2024-12-31'.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category number, 0 = all categories (e.g. 18 = Shopping, 71 = Food & Drink, 958 = Jobs, 5 = Computers & Electronics).

includeInterestOverTime.title: Interest over time
includeInterestOverTime.description: Timeline of 0-100 values for each term.

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: Countries (worldwide), states/regions (country) or cities/metros (region) ranked by interest.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries (top & rising)
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising related searches for each term, including 'Breakout' queries.

includeRelatedTopics.title: Related topics (single terms only)
includeRelatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics. Google only shows these for single-term searches and sometimes returns none.

regionResolution.title: Region resolution
regionResolution.description: Granularity of 'Interest by region'. auto = countries for Worldwide, regions for a country, cities for a region.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions with low search volume.

trendingNowGeos.title: Trending Now: countries
trendingNowGeos.description: Also return today's trending searches (with approximate traffic and news links) for these countries, e.g. 'US', 'GB'. Charged per trending search returned.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language for region and topic names, e.g. 'en-US', 'de', 'he'.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel reports
maxConcurrency.description: Higher is faster but Google rate-limits sooner. 1-10.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is used by default. If Google rate-limits the datacenter IPs, the Actor switches to residential automatically (you are not charged extra).

allowResidentialFallback.title: Auto-switch to residential proxy when rate-limited
allowResidentialFallback.description: Keeps runs reliable when Google returns HTTP 429. No extra charge to you.
